name: Tamron
source: https://www.tamron.com/common/images/logo.svg (official Tamron Co., Ltd. site logo; blue .cls-2 wordmark path only, grey 'Focus on the Future' tagline dropped). Cross-checked against https://www.tamron.eu/_nuxt/tamron.Bvo-uYXR.svg (Tamron Europe site logo, IoU 0.99). Licensing basis: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Tamron_Logo_2019.svg
license: Public domain (PD-textlogo on Wikimedia Commons for this wordmark design); trademark of Tamron Co., Ltd.
notes: Current (2019+) TAMRON wordmark. Geometry taken from the official tamron.com logo.svg (single path, no transforms), made absolute and rounded to 0.01; viewBox is the exact path bbox. An earlier build used the Commons Tamron_Logo_2019.svg path, but that file is a lighter/wider variant (stems ~9% thinner, aspect 6.51 vs 6.37, IoU 0.91 against both official sites), so it was replaced. Counters (A, R, O) render as holes with both nonzero and evenodd; nonzero kept to match the source. Brand colour #005BAC (site) / #005BAA (EU) / #005CA9 (Commons).
